map.从内置 20 条绕口令中随机抽题，显示文本、条目序号与人工标注的难度（简单/中等: Draws a random tongue twister from a built-in library of 20, showing the text, item number and hand-labelled difficulty (easy / medium / hard / hell). Click Start or Next to draw again, avoiding an immediate repeat. This page does not record audio, time you or score you.
map.内置 20 条绕口令，覆盖简单到地狱 4 档难度: A built-in library of 20 tongue twisters across 4 difficulty levels from easy to hell
map.随机抽题并避开上一条，避免连续重复: Random draws skip the previous item to avoid immediate repeats
map.纯前端运行，无需联网、不上传数据: Runs entirely in the front end with no network or upload
map.播音、口才课前热身: Warm-up before broadcasting or public speaking classes
map.打开工具，点「开始」从题库随机抽题；页面显示文本、序号与难度。: Open the tool and click Start to draw a random prompt; the text, item number and difficulty appear.
map.大声朗读当前绕口令；需要换题时点「下一条」。: Read the current tongue twister aloud; click Next when you want another one.
map.想回到初始提示时点「重置」。难度标签来自题库人工分类，不是实时计算。: Click Reset to return to the initial prompt. Difficulty labels are hand-assigned in the library, not computed live.
map.先慢读准每个字，再逐步加速，比一开始就追求速度更有效。: Read each word slowly and accurately first, then speed up; this works better than chasing speed from the start.
map.按标点分句练习，卡壳时回到短句，熟练后再连读整条。: Practise clause by clause; when you stumble, return to the short clause and join the whole line once fluent.
map.需要记录自己的发音时，请使用手机自带录音或其他应用；本页不录音、不计时、不评分。: To record your own pronunciation, use your phone's recorder or another app; this page does not record, time or score.
map.能加自己的绕口令吗？: Can I add my own tongue twisters?
map.不能。当前只从内置 20 条题库随机抽取；可复制文本到别处自行练习。: No. It only draws from the 20 built-in items; you can copy the text elsewhere to practise.
map.会计时、录音或评分吗？: Does it time, record or score me?
map.不会。本页只做随机展示与难度标注，不含计时器、录音、语音识别或评分功能。: No. The page only displays random prompts and difficulty labels; it has no timer, recorder, speech recognition or scoring.
